title: Developer Implementation Document — Story-by-Story Workbook
description: Enterprise developer handover document for the AIG Japan Auto platform. Produced by the Developer stage (S6) of the SDLC lifecycle. Self-contained per-story workbook: each story entry carries everything a developer or Claude Code needs to implement that story independently — user story, Gherkin AC, FR delta, business rules, code stubs, and Definition of Done.
document_intent: Hand this document to a developer or Claude Code together with the original codebase. Instruction: 'Here is the codebase at input/Auto/ and here is the Developer Handover Document. Read Section 1 for the full requirement, then implement each story in Section 2 in order.'

required_before_developer_stage: FSD stage (ANALYSIS → FSD) — populates FR deltas (as-is → to-be) and business rules per story
Stories stage (FSD → STORIES) — populates user story narrative, Gherkin AC, priority, points
Architecture stage (STORIES → ARCHITECTURE) — populates code stubs (CMP-*/API-* KB cards) and integration wiring
pipeline_prerequisites.consequence_if_missing: Story fields will show stub placeholders. Re-run missing upstream stages, then re-generate this document.

sections.title: 1. Change Summary
sections.description: Workspace metadata + full requirement text. This is the anchor context that Claude Code / developer reads first.
fields: requirement (full text — the complete business requirement from INTAKE)

sections.title: 2. Story-by-Story Implementation Workbook
sections.description: THE primary section. One self-contained entry per story from the SRD. Each entry is a complete developer brief for that story. Code stubs are embedded here (NOT in a separate section) so the developer never needs to cross-reference.

story_entry_fields.format: Table: Repo | File Path (corpus) | Stack | Action | Ownership
story_entry_fields.description: THE primary action table — the first thing a developer or Claude Code reads. Shows exactly which file to open and change. File paths are extracted from KB card source_loci (e.g. 'input/Auto/CodeBase/UI-NewBusiness/src/app/newbusiness/quote/quote.component.ts'). Repo column = the folder name directly under input/Auto/CodeBase/ (e.g. UI-NewBusiness, Services-NewBusiness, AdobeForms). Action = MODIFY for existing files, ADD for new files with no locus.
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Missing = Architecture stage not yet run. Re-run Architecture stage to populate source loci.

story_entry_fields.description: Story title — must start with Enable/Allow/Provide/Support (from Stories stage). Minimum 8 words.
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Short or one-word title = Stories stage not yet run
Always 'Medium' when Stories stage has not run
Always 0 when Stories stage has not run

story_entry_fields.format: As a {as_a}, I want {i_want}, so that {so_that}.
story_entry_fields.description: Full narrative user story. Names actual systems (AIG Connect, PEGA, WOD, ESB, FREIA, ASACDP) and specific field names/flags.
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Empty / '⚠️ Stories stage not yet run' = Stories stage must run first

story_entry_fields.description: QA-testable Gherkin acceptance criteria. THEN clause must name what is stored, displayed, or returned — specific enough for an automated test.
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Empty / '⚠️ Run Stories stage first' = Stories stage must run first

story_entry_fields.format: Table: FR ID | Title | Current Behaviour (as-is) | Required Change (to-be)
story_entry_fields.description: Exact behaviour change per Functional Requirement. The developer implements the 'to-be' column. 'as-is' is what the current code does.
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Empty table = FSD stage has not run, or FSD has no as_is/to_be for this FR

story_entry_fields.description: Business rules that govern this story. Developer must not implement logic that violates these rules. Surfaced from FSD (developer persona cannot read BR-* cards directly).
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Empty = FSD stage has not run, or no BR-* cards linked to this story's screens

story_entry_fields.source: SRD.component_design (CMP-*/API-* KB cards) via deterministic stack detection
story_entry_fields.format: Per stub: filename | KB card ID | stack | language | source locus | ownership | code template
story_entry_fields.description: Template-based code stubs grouped by story. DEV-TODO sections must be implemented. ESB/XDP/PEGA stubs are reference-only (no source file changes).
story_entry_fields.stub_indicator: Empty = Architecture SRD has no CMP-*/API-* cards, or all KB cards are outside developer-visible kinds

story_entry_fields.description: CMP-* KB card IDs of components to change. Cross-reference with corpus: input/Auto/ source path from KB card source_locus.
API-* KB card IDs of API endpoints to add or modify.
SCR-* KB card IDs of AIG Connect screens affected.
INT-* KB card IDs of integration points to configure. Protocol + endpoint from SRD integration_design.

story_entry_fields.source: Derived from gherkin_ac (Given/When/Then) + kb_ids (CMP-*/API-* unit tests) + integrations
story_entry_fields.format: Checklist items — each is a verifiable completion criterion
story_entry_fields.description: Developer completes all items before QA handover. Each item maps to a Gherkin clause or a KB card.

story_entry_fields.source: Token overlap between story title and matched KB card labels
story_entry_fields.description: Confidence that KB evidence covers this story. 'gap' = architect review required before implementation.

story_entry_fields.source: Detected from KB card source_locus (stack detection) + gap_status
story_entry_fields.values: AUTO = stubs fully generated | HYBRID = partial | DEV-TODO = all manual
story_entry_fields.description: AUTO means the stub is ready to implement; DEV-TODO means the developer must design the implementation from scratch.

sections.title: 3. Architecture Context
sections.description: System components and integrations from the accepted SRD. Reference only — do not modify without Architect sign-off.

sections.title: 4. Full Code Stubs (copy-paste index)
sections.description: All code stubs in one consolidated place for copy-paste reference. Same content as embedded in Section 2 — listed here as a developer convenience index grouped by story and stack.

sections.title: 5. Integration Wiring Checklist
sections.description: One row per INT-* card from the SRD. Protocol, endpoint, from-component, and to-component must be confirmed before QA handover. ESB changes go through IBM ACE Toolkit — no source file edits.

sections.title: 6. REGO Policy Stubs
sections.description: OPA/REGO authorisation policy stubs — one per screen (SCR-*) affected by this change. Developer must update allowed personas from personas.json before QA handover.

sections.title: 7. Test Expectations
sections.description: Auto-derived test cases from Gherkin AC + DoD. QA engineer uses these as the starting point for the formal test plan. Happy-path + negative test case per story.

sections.title: 8. Gap Log
sections.description: All DEV-TODO items, SME-required gaps, and compliance gaps. Every gap must be resolved or escalated before QA handover. Resolution process: compliance_gap → escalate immediately; gap+sme_required → standup; partial → implement best-effort; deferred → backlog ticket.

sections.title: 9. Handover Checklist
sections.description: Developer signs off before QA handover. Three categories: Development (stubs implemented, no DEV-TODO), Quality (tests pass, Sonar clean), Governance (gaps resolved, KB IDs valid, workspace advanced).

ownership_values.AUTO: Code stub fully generated from KB card — developer fills DEV-TODO sections and adds tests
ownership_values.HYBRID: Partial stub — developer must complete implementation sections marked DEV-TODO
ownership_values.DEV-TODO: No KB evidence — developer designs implementation from scratch. Raise with Architect.

gap_status_values.direct: KB card confidence ≥ 0.7 — high confidence, implement from stub
gap_status_values.derived: KB card confidence 0.4–0.69 — reasonable inference, validate with BA before implementing
gap_status_values.partial: KB card confidence 0.4–0.69 with some overlap — implement best-effort, flag in code comments
gap_status_values.gap: KB card confidence < 0.4 or no CMP/API card found — Architect review required before implementation
gap_status_values.compliance_gap: Compliance requirement — cannot defer. Escalate immediately.
gap_status_values.deferred: Acknowledged but deferred to v2 — create backlog ticket with workspace_id reference

stack_values.angular: Angular/TypeScript — UI-NewBusiness, UI-Endorsement repos in input/Auto/CodeBase/
stack_values.ibm_esb: IBM ESB/ESQL — changes go through IBM ACE Toolkit, NOT source files
stack_values.adobe_xdp: Adobe LiveCycle XDP — AdobeForms repo. JA-language labels need SME review (needs-ja-sme).
stack_values.sql: SQL/Oracle — ASACDP database. DBA review + Flyway migration required.
stack_values.pega: PEGA — changes through PEGA Studio, NOT source files. Reference only.
stack_values.unknown: No source_locus or unrecognised path — developer must locate source file manually

note: Code stubs are embedded IN each story_workbook entry (not in a separate flat list) so the developer/Claude Code has a single self-contained brief per story. The 'Files to Touch' table in each story is derived at render-time from KB card source_loci — never hardcoded — so it always reflects what the knowledge base knows about the actual corpus. Section 4 (Full Code Stubs) is a convenience index. Sections 3–9 are supplementary reference — Section 2 is the primary delivery.
